shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && find src -type f | head -100

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo ---- && rg -n -C 3 -i 'i18n' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120 && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

sed -n 305,330p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; grep -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n"' -A4 package-lock.json | head; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>&1 | head -3; echo ---- README i18n; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md; echo ---- i18n dts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/cjs/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/cjs/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo ---- uikit configure; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ---- traps; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -name 'configure.d.ts' -o -name 'index.d.ts' -path '*utils/configure*' | head; echo ----; cat $(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -path '*components/utils/configure*' -name '*.d.ts' | head -3); echo ---- i18n hook; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -path '*i18n*' -name '*.d.ts' | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/i18n.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---- exports; grep -n -i 'configure\|getConfig\|Lang' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---- traps tail; sed -n 260,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ---- icons; grep -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons"' -B2 -A6 package-lock.json | head -20; grep -n 'Globe\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -3; echo ---- segmented; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | grep -i 'segment\|RadioButton\|Select$'

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ---- i18n uikit; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/addLanguageKeysets.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/addComponentKeysets.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/i18n.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/types.d.ts; echo ---- SRG; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---- README SRG; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ---- Alert/Pagination props with built-in i18n; grep -rl 'i18n' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/*/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/i18n/ 2>/dev/null
